# langsmith_managed_tool_profile (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith Managed Tools profile: a named identity whose tool credentials an admin configures for an agent or other non-user caller. Callers select it with the `X-LangSmith-Profile` header. Requires a user-owned API key with `workspaces:credentials:manage`. Deleting a profile deletes its tool credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_managed_tool_profile" "agent" {
  name = "Support agent"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Profile name, unique within the workspace.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace that owns this profile. Defaults to the provider workspace. Use `workspace_id/profile_id` when importing into a workspace other than the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Profile ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langsmith_managed_tool_profile.agent '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'
terraform import langsmith_managed_tool_profile.agent '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'
```
